gbm_population_evidence.quote: High Grade Glioma; Meningioma; Embryonal Tumor; Medulloblastoma; Anaplastic Ependymoma

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: that is recurrent, progressive, or refractory

role_evidence.quote: Lutathera: IV administration maximum dose of 200 mCi once every 8 weeks (one cycle) for total of 4 cycles (8 months)

agents.stated_antitumour_mechanism: radionuclide therapy which binds type-2A somatostatin receptors (SST2A)

source_quote.quote: Describe prevalence and heterogeneity of SST2A expression (IHC) in patients with recurrent or progressive High-Grade CNS tumors or meningiomas

coder_notes: No explicit glioblastoma mention in conditions, title, eligibility or arm label (only high-grade glioma / malignant glioma / DIPG etc.), so high_grade_glioma_unspecified. Entry requires DOTATATE PET uptake (imaging selection, not coded as a molecular biomarker); SST2A IHC is only a correlative outcome. Population includes children 4-<12 and AYA up to 39.
